summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in the constructor and set/cleared in run(). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests; all pass on the venv's Python 3.9 when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src/. Full suite (excluding snapshot, cli and devtools tests) shows 68 failures both before and after the change, caused by the missing async test plugin, so none are new. Nothing committed. Note: the venv's textual resolves to base/src, so PYTHONPATH must be set to test this repo's code.
